coaching.headline: Eden snowballed from the duo lane to 17 kills, and none of the three allied fight wins was cashed into a structure.

flags.text: Damn duo-lane buffet: Eden scored six duo-lane kills in the allied half and razed the duo outer.
Mourn razed the offlane inner after the duo-lane win and the offlane inhibitor after the Fangtooth-pit win.
Four allied deaths surrounded the first Fangtooth take, Narbash's at the pit, against three Aurora kills.
Mourn killed Crunch all four times and finished with the game's most hero damage and healing.

focus.title: Starve Eden, then take towers
focus.action: After an Eden kill on the duo lane, Kira and Narbash skip the next trade until Aurora shows on the duo side; after each won fight, the team hits the nearest enemy tower.

23.call: Enemy Fangtooth fell first; then a fight won 3-2, Lt. Belica killing Eden and Steel at the pit and Mourn killing Crunch in the allied jungle. Mourn then razed the offlane inhibitor. After a pit win, one ally guards the offlane inhibitor.

21.4.call: Lost 1-3: Argus killed Lt. Belica in the allied jungle, Kira killed Steel on the mid lane, then Eden killed Narbash and Kira there. Once an ally drops, the remaining allies back off mid instead of trading.

25.3.call: Eden razed the allied duo inhibitor, then killed Aurora, Lt. Belica and Kira in the allied base; Argus took the mid inner and inhibitor, and Mourn the Core. With two inhibitors down, the first stun goes on Eden.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Five of six deaths went to Eden: two on the mid lane, two at the Fangtooth pit, the last in the allied base. Before entering a pit, find Eden first.
Three kills around the first Fangtooth, on Argus, Wukong and Steel; hero damage 446 per minute on a 566 norm. After each Fangtooth, path to the duo side.
The death to Mourn on the offlane in the enemy half came outside any detected fight. If wards were equipped, ward the enemy offlane jungle entrance before ganking there.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: All four deaths went to Mourn, starting with first blood on the offlane in the allied half. Before trading with Mourn early, wait until Aurora shows on the offlane side.
Took the only allied structure, the enemy offlane outer, and scored Mourn's only death. After the next kill on Mourn, push the offlane tower before Mourn respawns.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Seven deaths, 72% over norm, three each to Argus and Eden; one came right after Argus razed the mid outer. Deploy the drone before trading Argus.
Killed Eden and Steel at the Fangtooth pit after enemy Fangtooth, with hero damage 17% over the norm. In pit fights, save the silence for Eden.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Seven deaths, 114% over norm, six to Eden; a duo-lane death outside any detected fight preceded Eden razing the duo outer. While Eden is unseen, stay behind the duo tower.
Hit back with three kills on Eden, then died to Eden mid, right after a Steel kill. After a Steel kill with Eden still up, back off.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Hell of a support line: 81% kill participation, 18068 healing, 10 wards on an 8.6 norm. After Eden scores a duo-lane kill, ward the duo side next.
Two duo-lane deaths to Eden came after Eden razed the duo outer. Once the duo outer is down, hold the Sanctification shield for Eden's next engage.

matchup: Wukong was the jungle opponent; Aurora killed Wukong once and Wukong never killed Aurora.
Wukong put 15111 damage into objectives, second only to Eden's 17239 among all ten players.
build: Magnify's ability hits on heroes cut magical armor 6% for 3.5s, stacking up to 5 times.
Tainted Guard cuts an attacker's healing 45% for 3s only when a basic attack hits Aurora.
Spirit Of Amir and Spectral Schematics, two of the 50.2% winning core, never made the build.
eternal: Krix adds max health that grows per level; Cannibalism adds 25 max health per takedown.
Vesh leans ahead in the Aurora jungle field; Krix ranks third of three Eternals with enough games.
Regenerative Tissue with Predator is the only Krix pair with enough games; the Voracity and Cannibalism run has too few.
augment: Glacial Thorns makes Glacial Charge spawn Hoarfrost Crystals that deal damage and root.
Glacial Thorns leans ahead in the Aurora jungle field. Sound keep.
crest: Winter's Fury active: an expanding icy sphere deals damage, slows, and makes damaged enemies take 10% more magical damage.
Winter's Fury and Typhoon are even in the Aurora jungle field; Winter's Fury holds the lead. Sound keep.
Winter's Fury evolves from Warlock Crest.
improvement: Vesh over Krix is the field-backed swap: damage over time on ability hits, giving up stacking max health.
A magical-armor item in place of World Breaker trades stacking magic damage for protection against three magical enemies.

matchup: Mourn was the lane opponent and the enemy team's only healer, running Lotus with Fragrance for bonus magical damage.
Mourn built a magical kit, Magnify and Wraith Leggings included, the damage type Tainted Bastion answers.
Mourn's RMB channels vines that pull enemies in and slow.
build: Tainted Bastion cuts the source's healing 45% for 3s whenever Crunch takes magical damage.
Augmentation and Mutilator are two of the 45.7% winning core; Salvation never made the build.
Mutilator's ability hits on heroes apply Mutilate three times, each dealing 1% of the target's max health.
eternal: Knell's Rust stacks shred physical and magical armor; with Peal, attacks and abilities apply maximum Rust after an ultimate cast.
Knell has too few games to lead the Crunch offlane field; Vesh leans ahead among Eternals with enough games.
No Knell minor pair has enough games; Frequency with Fracture is the most played pair.
augment: Combo Crunch: Cross Crunch damage grants 7.5% total attack speed for 3s, stacking up to 4 times.
Combo Crunch is the only Crunch offlane augment with enough games to lead: most played, no edge claimed.
crest: Judgement's Thunder Cleaver active deals area damage and heals on hero hits.
Iceskorn Talons is clearly best in the Crunch offlane field; Judgement ranks second.
Judgement and Iceskorn Talons both evolve from Champion Crest.
improvement: Iceskorn Talons over Judgement is the field-backed swap: an ice sheet that buffs allies and slows enemies, giving up the heal.
Vesh over Knell trades the armor shred for damage over time on ability hits.

matchup: Argus was the lane opponent: three Argus kills on Lt. Belica, one Lt. Belica kill on Argus.
Argus razed the mid outer, mid inner and mid inhibitor, every mid structure that fell.
Argus's Q orb stuns enemies hit in a small area.
build: Combustion and Wraith Leggings are two of the 50.5% winning core; Noxia never made the build.
Overseer, the last item finished, adds 15% ultimate damage and heals for 25% of ultimate damage to heroes.
Wraith Leggings adds 12% bonus magical ability damage against heroes below 40% health.
eternal: Mind Rot makes the Vesh major also deal 2% of the target's current health as bonus damage.
Lotus and Vesh are even in the Lt. Belica mid field; Lotus holds the lead. Sound keep on Vesh.
The Tenth Seal with Millennia is the best Vesh pair; the Tithe of Death and Mind Rot run ranks second.
augment: Devastating Bombs: Void Bomb deals 15% more damage to isolated targets.
Combat Veteran leans ahead in the Lt. Belica mid field; Devastating Bombs, the most played, ranks third.
crest: Epoch's Stasis Device active puts the wearer in stasis for 2.5s.
Typhoon leans ahead in the Lt. Belica mid field; Epoch, the most played, ranks second among crests with enough games.
Epoch evolves from Wizard Crest; Typhoon evolves from Warlock Crest.
improvement: Combat Veteran over Devastating Bombs is the field-backed swap: movement speed and passive experience, giving up isolated-target bomb damage.
Typhoon over Epoch trades the stasis escape for attack speed stacks and a dash.

matchup: Duo was Kira and Narbash against Eden and Steel; the allied duo died three times before minute ten, the enemy duo once.
Eden built the same Scattershot, Tainted Rounds and Vanquisher core and also finished Terminus and Imperator.
Eden's melee stance restores health equal to a share of damage dealt to heroes.
build: None of the 56.1% winning core, Solaris, Ashbringer and Imperator, made the build.
Tainted Rounds, the last item finished, cuts the target's healing 45% for 3s on basic-attack hits.
Vanquisher executes a hero taken below 5% health.
eternal: Vermis: every third consecutive basic attack on a hero deals bonus max-health damage; Serration adds missing-health damage.
Xyris, Vermis and Weald are even in the Kira carry field; Xyris holds the lead. Sound keep on Vermis.
Serration with Breach is the best Vermis pair; the Serration and Melting Point run ranks second.
augment: Bringer Of Mercy: Mercy costs 10 less mana and cuts current ability cooldowns 0.75s on dealing damage.
Bringer Of Mercy, Lenore and Siphoning Purge are even in the Kira carry field; Bringer Of Mercy holds the lead. Sound keep.
crest: Pacifier's Adrenalize active dashes and empowers the next physical hit, recastable after a quick hero kill.
Liberator and Pacifier are even in the Kira carry field; Liberator holds the lead. Sound keep.
Pacifier and Liberator both evolve from Sharpshooter Crest.
improvement: Breach over Melting Point is the field-backed minor: ultimate damage shreds physical armor 35%, giving up the high-armor bonus.
Liberator over Pacifier trades the dash for a cleanse and shield; the field rates the two even.

matchup: Duo against Eden and Steel: Steel scored no kills and died six times, twice to Kira.
Eden killed Narbash three times; Argus killed Narbash twice.
Steel's Q charge stuns and knocks back heroes.
build: Truesilver Bracelet, Crystal Tear and Dynamo is the full 60.4% winning core.
Dynamo makes immobilized enemies take 8% more damage for 2.5s, a fit with the Thunk stun.
Truesilver Bracelet grants a shield and crowd-control immunity after casting the ultimate.
eternal: Lotus randomly grants damage, ability haste, move speed or max health on a timer and on every takedown.
Exarch and Krix are even in the Narbash support field; Exarch holds the lead and Lotus has too few games.
No Lotus minor pair has enough games; Flawless with Immaculate is the most played.
augment: Thonk: a Thunk that hits an enemy drops, and picking the drumstick up refunds 35% cooldown and 50% mana cost.
Thonk and Percussive Tear are even in the Narbash support field; Thonk holds the lead. Sound keep.
crest: Sanctification's Safeguard active shields nearby heroes for 3s, with 50% tenacity while the shield holds.
Sanctification leans ahead in the Narbash support field. Sound keep.
Sanctification evolves from Warden Crest; the passive raises the ward cap from 2 to 3.
improvement: Exarch over Lotus is the field-backed swap: attack speed and on-hit magic damage for healed allies, giving up random takedown gains.
The items matched the winning core; no item change is proven.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Mourn Abduct (pull). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Mourn. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 3 items of it.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s), Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Narbash) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Thunk stun → March! speed → Song heal aura → Crash Bang Boom! AoE slow ult
ourKits.winCondition: engage with Thunk and group-buff the team through fights
ourKits.playWith: a dive team that rides his speed and heal
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge/cleanse Thunk; he's low-damage — kill his carry through the aura

ourKits.combo: Mercy poke → stack Vengeance → Shadow Glide reposition → Purge ult
ourKits.winCondition: stack Vengeance and shred with the channeled Purge
ourKits.playWith: peel so she can channel Purge safely
ourKits.playAgainst: interrupt/CC her during Purge; punish her short dash cooldown

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
ourKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

ourKits.combo: Forward Crunch gap-close stun → Right Crunch knockup → empowered Left Crunch, sustain via Re-Crunch
ourKits.winCondition: all-in a squishy with the empowered combo and heal back through Re-Crunch
ourKits.passive: post-ability empowered basic that refunds cooldowns
ourKits.playWith: peel-stripping engage so he reaches the backline
ourKits.playAgainst: peel/CC him off — without resets he's stranded; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch

enemyKits.combo: Dread Nova stun → Ether Crystal push/lift → Particle Shredder channel → Synaptic Obliterator beams
enemyKits.winCondition: poke from max range and zone with the crystal
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline to protect his stationary channel
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova; dive him during the immobile ult channel

enemyKits.combo: Windsurge engage → Cyclebreaker damage-reduction spin → clones from 84000 Hairs
enemyKits.winCondition: stance-dance for damage or tankiness and overwhelm with clones
enemyKits.playWith: a team that fights alongside his clones
enemyKits.playAgainst: AoE clears his clones; CC him during the damage-reduction window

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
enemyKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
enemyKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

enemyKits.combo: stance-swap with Zero Shift → Tachyon Lance (ranged) or melee chain → Limit Break on Overheat
enemyKits.winCondition: build Heat and burst with Limit Break, flexing range and melee
enemyKits.passive: damage builds Heat → Overheat unlocks Limit Break
enemyKits.playWith: peel that lets her ramp Heat safely
enemyKits.playAgainst: pressure her before Overheat; CC during the melee stance

enemyKits.combo: Abduct pull → Contagion ally-heal bugs → Beguile damage-reduction → Eclipse vision-denial ult
enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and sustain the team through the brawl
enemyKits.playWith: burst that punishes his pulled target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect the long Abduct channel/range; anti-heal blunts Contagion
